title: Floor Core - C
texts: A simple core workout which requires nothing but floor space and some small weights

Weighted Twist - Starting in lying positionwith your knees bent, sit up into a crunch position and begin to twist your upper body from side to side. Holding a heavier weight will make this exercise harder. Complete 15 reps total which equates to 15 turns on both sides. That's 30 movements total. 

V sits - Try to extend the body as much as possible and keep your legs and arms straight on the sit up element.. Complete 15 reps per set.

Superman - Start in plank before extending your hands and feet as far apart as possible on alternating sides in turn. Complete 15 reps total which equates to 15 reaches on both sides. That's 30 movements total. 

Rest 1 minute between sets and exercises.

You may add ankle and/or wrist weights to increase the intensity, or you may reduce the rest between sets or add reps. Reduce the volume of reps to decrease the intensity.
